sensors.description: ESP32 and other sensor devices that send readings to WallX Play. Show their values on screens and get alerts when something is wrong.
sensors.name: Name
sensors.offlineAfterHint: Minutes without a reading before an offline alert is raised (2–1440).
sensors.offlineAfterError: Enter a whole number of minutes from 2 to 1440.
sensors.emptyBody: Add a device to get its API key, then add channels (such as temperature or door) that it reports.
sensors.notInPlanTitle: Sensors are not included in your plan
sensors.notInPlanBody: Upgrade to a plan with ESP32 sensors to connect devices and show live data on screens.
sensors.notFound: This sensor device does not exist or was deleted.
sensors.keyOnce: Copy this key now. It is shown only once; if it is lost, rotate the key and update the device.
sensors.keyHelp: Put the key in the device firmware. The device sends readings as JSON with the key as a Bearer token, for example:
sensors.rotateBody: A new key is issued and the current key stops working immediately. The device sends no readings until its firmware has the new key.
sensors.deleteBody: “{{name}}”, its channels and all stored readings will be deleted. Alert history is kept. This cannot be undone.

channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No channels yet. Add one for each value the device reports.
channels.keyHint: What the device sends, e.g. temp or door_1. Cannot be changed later.
channels.name: Name
channels.rangeHint: Readings outside the range are rejected as faulty. Leave empty for no limit.
channels.staleAfterHint: No new reading for this long marks the value stale on screens and raises a stale alert.
channels.rulesHint: An alert opens when a reading matches a rule and closes when readings are back to normal.
channels.rulesHintBoolean: On / off readings are compared as 1 (on) and 0 (off), e.g. “== 1” for door open.
channels.hysteresisHint: Hysteresis: how far the value must move back past the limit before the alert closes, so it does not flap.
channels.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and its stored readings will be deleted. The device's readings for it will be rejected.

alerts.description: Threshold, stale-data and offline alerts from your sensors.

sensorWidgets.noChannels: Sensor widgets need a sensor channel. Add one on the Sensors page first.
sensorWidgets.label: Caption
sensorWidgets.bandsHint: The first matching band colours the value and shows its label.
sensorWidgets.statesHint: Match a number (e.g. 2) or on / off. The first match is shown.
